body: Bro said “It’s Lit” and then dipped Travis Scott barely even appears on NAV’s “Young Wheezy,” but somehow his two-word moment still stands out. He pops in, says his part, and disappears like he was never supposed to stay for the whole song. NAV and Gunna carry most of the track, with Gunna switching up his usual laid-back flow and matching the fast-paced energy of the beat. The whole song has that classic Wheezy bounce that makes it hard to sit still.

source_caption_text:
Bro said “It’s Lit” and then dipped

Travis Scott barely even appears on NAV’s “Young Wheezy,” but somehow his two-word moment still stands out. He pops in, says his part, and disappears like he was never supposed to stay for the whole song. 

NAV and Gunna carry most of the track, with Gunna switching up his usual laid-back flow and matching the fast-paced energy of the beat. The whole song has that classic Wheezy bounce that makes it hard to sit still.

And then there’s Travis, casually dropping two words and dipping. You really gotta love when an artist can make a tiny appearance and still have everyone talking about it.
